DescribeImageModerationResult.description_en: Retrieves the results of an Image Moderation Pro task
DescribeImageModerationResult.description_zh: 获取图片审核增强版审核任务结果

DescribeImageResultExt.description_en: The enhanced image moderation auxiliary information API operation retrieves additional auxiliary information detected by the enhanced image moderation API operation, including OCR results and custom image library hit information
DescribeImageResultExt.description_zh: 图片审核增强版辅助信息API用于获取图片审核增强版API接口识别的更多辅助信息，包含图片文字识别结果、自定义图库命中信息等

DescribeMultimodalModerationResult.description_en: Query the results of an asynchronous multimodal moderation task
DescribeMultimodalModerationResult.description_zh: 查询异步多模态检测结果

DescribeUrlModerationResult.description_en: Queries moderation results based on the ReqId returned by asynchronous URL moderation
DescribeUrlModerationResult.description_zh: 根据 URL 异步检测返回的 ReqId查询检测结果

ImageAsyncModeration.description_en: This API is used for asynchronous image moderation. Asynchronous moderation tasks do not return detection results in real time. You can obtain the detection results using a callback or by polling. The detection results are retained for up to three days
ImageAsyncModeration.description_zh: 图片异步检测接口，异步检测任务不会实时返回检测结果，您需要通过callback或者轮询的方式获取检测结果。检测结果最长保留3天

ManualCallback.description_en: The channel callback API for manual review results in Content Moderation
ManualCallback.description_zh: 内容安全人审结果渠道回调接口

ManualModeration.description_en: Interface for submitting Content Moderation manual review requests
ManualModeration.description_zh: 内容安全人审提交请求接口

ManualModerationResult.description_en: Retrieves the manual review result for content moderation

MultiModalAgent.description_en: Synchronously detects content by calling the multimodal Agent API

MultiModalAgentSSE.description_en: Synchronously moderates multimodal content through the Agent API

MultiModalGuard.description_zh: AI安全护栏多模态同步检测接口，包括内容合规检测、敏感内容检测、提示词攻击检测、恶意文件检测、恶意URL检测等全方位检测能力

MultiModalGuardAsync.description_en: An asynchronous multimodal AI safety guardrail API for audio and video. It provides comprehensive detection of non-compliant content, sensitive content, prompt injection attacks, malicious files, and malicious URLs
MultiModalGuardAsync.description_zh: AI安全护栏多模态异步检测接口，支持音频、视频模态，包括内容合规检测、敏感内容检测、提示词攻击检测、恶意文件检测、恶意URL检测等全方位检测能力

MultiModalGuardAsyncResult.description_en: Queries the asynchronous results of AI safety guardrail multimodal content moderation, supporting audio and video modalities
MultiModalGuardAsyncResult.description_zh: AI安全护栏多模态异步结果查询接口，支持音频、视频模态

MultiModalGuardForBase64.description_en: Performs synchronous multimodal content moderation. Supports image base64 strings
MultiModalGuardForBase64.description_zh: 多模态同步检测接口，支持图片base64字符串

MultiModalGuardWs.description_en: Provides a WebSocket-based multimodal detection API for AI safety guardrails. This API supports content compliance detection, sensitive content detection, prompt attack detection, malicious file detection, malicious URL detection, and other comprehensive detection capabilities
MultiModalGuardWs.description_zh: 支持websocket协议的AI安全护栏多模态检测接口，包括内容合规检测、敏感内容检测、提示词攻击检测、恶意文件检测、恶意URL检测等全方位检测能力

TextModeration.description_en: This service uses dynamic policies and models to defend against adversarial content. It provides moderation services for various business scenarios and detects different types of violations
TextModeration.description_zh: 采用动态策略和模型强化变异对抗性，提供多种业务场景的审核服务，识别出多种违规风险

TextModerationPlus.description_en: Text Moderation Plus is an upgraded service that moderates the input instructions and generated text of large language models (LLMs). This service can retrieve standard answers for specific input instructions and lets you enable or disable moderation labels
TextModerationPlus.description_zh: 文本审核增强版升级PLUS服务，面向大语言模型的输入指令和生成文字分别提供审核服务，特定的模型输入指令支持检索标准回答，同时开放审核标签的开启和关闭功能

UrlAsyncModeration.description_en: The URL asynchronous moderation service detects threats such as fraud, pornography, and gambling in URLs to protect the content ecosystem of your platform
UrlAsyncModeration.description_zh: URL异步检测服务，识别URL链接是否存在欺诈、色情、赌博等风险，守护平台内容生态

VideoModeration.description_en: The enhanced video moderation feature of Content Moderation detects threats and non-compliant content in video files. Use this operation to submit a moderation task
VideoModeration.description_zh: 内容安全视频审核增强版，帮助您检测视频文件中的风险或违规内容。本接口为检测任务提交接口

VideoModerationCancel.description_en: Cancels an ApsaraVideo Live content moderation node
VideoModerationCancel.description_zh: 取消视频直播审核任务

VideoModerationResult.description_en: Retrieves the task result of a video moderation node from the enhanced video moderation service
VideoModerationResult.description_zh: 获取视频审核增强版审核任务结果

VoiceModeration.description_en: Submits a task for enhanced voice moderation
VoiceModeration.description_zh: 提交语音审核增强版检测任务

VoiceModerationCancel.description_en: This operation cancels an enhanced voice moderation task
VoiceModerationCancel.description_zh: 语音审核增强版取消任务接口

VoiceModerationResult.description_en: Retrieve the detection results for enhanced voice moderation
VoiceModerationResult.description_zh: 语音审核增强版检测结果获取接口
